title: SensoTrue DM5, Givaudan's bio-based alternative to DM5 silicone in hair care
summary: Givaudan Active Beauty has just unveiled a new bio-based emollient developed through a combination of white biotechnology and green chemistry as an alternative to 5 cSt dimethicone (DM5 silicone). Designed to move with the hair rather than coat it, SensoTrue DM5 enables hair care formulations that deliver a responsive feel and lightweight performance. According to Givaudan Active Beauty, SensoTrue DM5 pairs premium sensory performance with a significantly improved environmental profile,... - Ingredients & formulation
